# Spectral Reflectance // make

> Free 3D-printable bag tag designs without NFC chips for the Earth Observation and geospatial community, created by Spectral Reflectance.

This personal maker project began with tags made for the Agentic AI for EO workshop in Berlin. The site currently offers two designs: Trust the Agent, Blame the Human, and STAC or It Doesn't Exist. The STAC tag adapts third-party artwork; its credits and rights are explained on the licence page.

Visitors can choose a design, select a predefined three-colour palette or set three custom colours, preview the front and back in 2D and the model in 3D, and download a 3MF or STL file. The 3MF contains separate colour parts; the STL has no colour information. Filament choices and sliced layers must be checked in Bambu Studio before printing.

Spectral Reflectance's own design work is shared for non-commercial use under CC BY-NC 4.0. See the licence page for attribution guidance and the separate rights of the adapted STAC artwork.

## Pages

- [Make website and customizer](https://www.make.spectralreflectance.space/): Choose colours, preview and download the tags.
- [Licence and artwork credits](https://www.make.spectralreflectance.space/licence/): Full terms, attribution and third-party artwork credits.
- [Spectral Reflectance publication](https://www.spectralreflectance.space/): Earth Observation publication by the creator.
